development-plan.goal: Establish Compass as the repository-wide AI engineering workflow without destabilizing the existing Turborepo, AGENTS hierarchy, or workspace ownership boundaries.

phase.name: Root semantic layer
phase.intent: Create a stable machine-readable contract layer for future agents.

phase.name: Instruction binding
phase.intent: Update active project rules so agents must consult and maintain the Compass documents.

phase.name: Incremental source scaffolding
phase.intent: Apply `MODULE_CONTRACT`, `MODULE_MAP`, `CHANGE_SUMMARY`, and paired semantic anchors to new files first, then to substantially edited or high-risk existing files when justified by a real task.

deliverable.name: RFC-0254 Quiet build/check logs

deliverable.name: RFC-0284 fleet Leitstand

deliverable.name: RFC-0852 Canonical Diagnostic schema ownership
deliverable.description: Moved canonical Diagnostic schema ownership from the site plugin into the engine. `packages/werkstatt/src/schemas/diagnostic.ts` is the sole owner of DiagnosticSeverity, DiagnosticEvidence, and Diagnostic strict Zod schemas and inferred types. Removed legacy aliases (auditSeveritySchema, auditEvidenceSchema, auditFindingSchema, AuditFinding) and deprecated fields (id, blockId, suggestion) repository-wide. The data field accepts only runtime-branded CanonicalJsonObjectV1 (RFC-0849).

deliverable.name: RFC-0858 Component and capability contracts
deliverable.description: Added strict versioned component manifests, capability provides/requires, attenuated grants, closed effect declarations, isolation requirements, lifecycle-owned resources, and canonical resolved-component-set identity in `packages/werkstatt/src/component/`. Strict Zod schemas reject unknown fields, invalid identities, duplicate provides, Law Kernel reserved grant scopes, and unknown effect/isolation/tier types. Canonical identity uses the existing fingerprint authority (snapshotCanonicalJsonObjectV1 + canonicalJsonHashV1). computeSetHash is input-order invariant and sensitive to every semantic field change. No registry, loader, sandbox, or plugin adapter exists in this module.

deliverable.name: RFC-0859 Lifecycle fiber and effect runtime
deliverable.description: Added structured-concurrency runtime in `packages/werkstatt/src/component-runtime/`. Closed lifecycle state machine (declared → waiting → loading → active → draining → unloading → disposed, plus failed/quarantined). Component fibers with bounded drain, LIFO effect unwind, and cancellation propagation. Four effect handlers: RevertibleEffectHandler (disposer required), TransactionalEffectHandler (prepare/commit/abort with idempotency), CompensatableEffectHandler (compensation with equivalence evidence), IrreversibleEmissionEffectHandler (withheld until commit). Activation transaction with prior-set drain in reverse dependency order and quarantine on incomplete rollback. No force unload, best-effort teardown, or swallowed disposer errors. 51 tests pass.

deliverable.name: RFC-0860 Deterministic component resolution and reconciliation
deliverable.description: Added pure deterministic resolver in `packages/werkstatt/src/component-runtime/resolver.ts`: validates manifests, checks artifact availability, verifies admitted grants, matches required capabilities by namespace/compatibility/schema identity, rejects zero/multiple providers, detects cycles, topologically sorts with canonical component-ID tie-breaking, computes graph/set identities through RFC-0858. Added reconciliation in `reconciliation.ts`: pure desired-state diff plans (stop/drain/unload/load/activate), no-op detection on unchanged setHash, RFC-0859 activation transaction orchestration. Added `resolution-proof.ts` with bounded proof/diagnostics types. Resolution is deterministic under input permutation. 71 tests pass.

deliverable.name: RFC-0861 Runtime reflection and conformance harness
deliverable.description: Added read-only, policy-filtered live capability catalog in `packages/werkstatt/src/component-runtime/reflection.ts`: `CapabilityCatalogV1` with canonically ordered, exact-set-bound, caller-filtered entries. Catalog omits secrets, raw grants, private state, credentials, prompts, executable bytes, and authority material — enforced by `assertNoForbiddenFields` and negative tests. Added scenario/result contracts in `conformance.ts`: `ConformanceScenarioV1`, `ConformanceResultV1` (always `testOnly: true`, no admission/promotion decision). Added test-only conformance harness in `testing/harness.ts`: `runConformanceScenario` with guards rejecting non-test mode (CONFORMANCE-01), untrusted fixtures (CONFORMANCE-02), unpinned artifacts (CONFORMANCE-03), and hash mismatches (CONFORMANCE-04). Fixtures are embedded, hash-pinned, and trusted. Subpath exports added for reflection, conformance, and testing. 28 tests pass.

deliverable.name: RFC-0862 Provider-neutral isolation contract
deliverable.description: Added provider-neutral isolation adapter contract in `packages/werkstatt/src/isolation/contracts.ts`: `IsolationAdapterV1`, `SandboxedWorkloadCreateV1`, `SandboxedWorkloadV1`, `CapabilityBridgeRequestV1`/ `ResponseV1`, `TerminationReportV1`, `AttenuatedGrantSetV1`, `WorkloadLimitsV1`, `IsolationPropertyEvidenceV1` with twelve required security properties. Workloads receive no ambient filesystem, network, process, environment, clock, randomness, credential, IPC, or host-object access. Added strict Zod schemas in `schemas.ts` with `.strict()` validation — unknown fields, invalid grants, replay, confused identity, and all bound violations rejected. Added adversarial conformance suite in `conformance.ts`: `runIsolationConformance` covering filesystem/network/process/env/credential/descriptor escape, resource exhaustion, workload separation, teardown, crash, bridge confusion/replay. `node:vm`, `worker_threads`, and ordinary subprocesses fail the security-tier contract by definition. Missing property evidence returns `incomplete`, never `pass`. Subpath exports added for contracts, schemas, and conformance. 27 tests pass.

deliverable.name: RFC-0853 Certification contracts and identity builders
deliverable.description: Added strict Zod schemas and inferred types for all CERT-001 certification objects in `packages/werkstatt/src/certification/contracts/`: identifiers (digests, candidate/evidence/decision/ action/event/operation/attempt IDs, authority sequences, timestamps, gate channels, environments, certification statuses, safe paths/locators), release candidates (build config, deployment plan, observed environment), policy bundles (producer/rubric/toolchain/issuer manifests, resolved requirements, risk policy, retention), evidence envelopes (payload descriptors, redaction reports, attestation statements, authority admissions, evidence results with RFC-0852 Diagnostics), dossier events (evidence-admitted, decision-recorded, incident, tombstone, manifest-projection, root-reference), decisions (gate, main verification, certification health with coverage reports and selected evidence), action packs (tasks, anchors, dependencies), authority artifacts (issuer registry, attestation verification, signed decision/root, operation authorization, non-authoritative preview), and deployment operation state/events. All schemas use `.strict()` validation — unknown fields fail without coercion. Added explicit identity builders in `identity.ts`: nine builders (release candidate, policy bundle, evidence, dossier event, gate decision, main verification, health decision, action pack, deployment operation event) that construct fresh payload objects field-by-field, snapshot through RFC-0849 `snapshotCanonicalJsonObjectV1`, and hash through `canonicalJsonHashV1`. Identity payloads include only semantic fields — excluded fields do not affect digests. Evidence identity enforces redaction closure (CERT-REDACTION-01 on unresolved redaction). Subpath export `@warpgogol/werkstatt/certification` added. 70 tests pass (42 contract + 28 identity PBT).

phase.name: LDD-oriented verification maturity
phase.intent: Standardize structured logs, reusable verification narratives, and XML issue reports for reusable runtime logic and complex workflows.

acceptance-gates.gate: Define and approve the canonical source markup contract before mass source-file rollout.
Generate repository inventory before adding drift enforcement or backfill automation.
Keep inventory and validation idempotent before introducing mutation-oriented scaffolding tools.
Roll out shared packages before app-layer mass adoption.

execution-loop.step: Update the relevant requirement and plan nodes before non-trivial implementation work.
Read `docs/knowledge-graph.xml` and the nearest `AGENTS.md` files to locate authoritative modules and boundaries.
Verbalize intent in the target module contract before editing code when touching non-trivial logic.
Implement inside stable semantic anchors and add structured logs when the behavior is complex enough to need trajectory inspection.
Update verification notes and root Compass documents if architectural reality changed.

When generating multi-line app boilerplate from packages, store templates under `src/templates//`, mirror the target app path in template paths, and keep onboarding/scaffold modules limited to minimal skeleton plus client-editable seed content.

test.walkthrough: Confirm the package is still app-agnostic, identify downstream apps, update graph links, and validate the package before each consumer.
Confirm the route remains thin, content ownership stays in the app content layer, and no middleware or localization invariant is silently broken.
Confirm the file has or should gain explicit invariants, stable anchors, and logs sufficient for post-change trajectory review.

source-markup-policy.rule: Do not retrofit the whole monorepo with semantic tags in one sweep.
Require Compass scaffolding for new non-trivial source files under `apps/` and `packages/`.
Backfill scaffolding during substantial edits to high-risk or hard-to-navigate files.
Keep semantic anchors stable so future patches can target them deterministically.
Use local invariants only where the source file is a true blast-radius boundary.
Do not embed long multi-line boilerplate literals directly in package generators when the output targets `apps/*`; externalize them into mirrored template files.

module.purpose: Typed configuration object with Zod schema. Single source of truth for LLM provider, release schedule, versioning thresholds, and cache paths.
Shared Zod schemas: RawCommit, ClassifiedCommit, GroupedRelease.
Prompt injection guard. sanitizeForPrompt() strips role markers, separators, injection patterns. Applied to all text fields before AI calls.
p-limit(5) wrapper. Prevents 429 errors during large-repo backfill.
Release window detection. Handles weekly/monthly modes. Clamps day-of-month to lastDayOfMonth to fix February-31 bug.
Git log extraction via simple-git. Extracts tree hash, diff summary (first 15 lines), files list. --no-merges by default.
Atomic file write via tmp+rename pattern. Prevents partial writes on crash.
SQLite WAL + file-based fallback cache. Composite key: TreeHash+files+diff+promptHash+modelVersion. Resilient to cherry-pick and squash merge.
AI classifier agent. Deterministic rules first, LLM as fallback. Adds confidence field. 3 retries + deterministic template on failure.
AI grouper agent. Clusters 50+ commits into 5-7 business groups by file path overlap and semantic proximity.
AI writer agent. Generates each section as a single coherent prose block. Past tense, no marketing language.
Confidence-gated SemVer bumper. feat→minor, fix→patch, breaking≥0.85→minor+flag, breaking<0.85→patch+requiresReview. Major locked.
Rebuilds CHANGELOG.md index entirely using dynamic markers. Restores missing markers. Writes versioned changelog-YYYY-MM-DD-vX.Y.Z.md files.
CLI orchestrator (commander). Commands: generate, rebuild-index, backfill, edit. Wires all modules together.
module.depends-on: M-CONFIG M-TYPES M-SCHED M-GIT M-SANIT M-CACHE M-LIMIT M-CLASS M-GROUP M-WRITE M-BUMPER M-INDEX

agent-runtime-certification-program.execution-law: Packets 000–240 are linear and non-parallel. Each packet requires preparation when applicable, a committed seal, one exclusive execution lease, canonical implementation commits, independent completion evidence, and a clean-tree handoff.

milestones.milestone: Bootstrap governance, complete Node 24 and canonical primitives, accept specification reconciliation.
Build component contracts, lifecycle/effects, resolution, reflection, and neutral isolation.
Bind and integrate the CERT-001 foundation with resolved runtime identity.
Materialize and implement certification profile, authority, orchestration, producers, and independent evaluator data workloads.
Admit one real sandbox and add governed capability evolution.
Restore deployment authority, monitor/demote, perform one combined cutover, and remove only proven-obsolete artifacts.

agent-runtime-certification-program.transition-policy: An intermediate repository may be broken. Do not add compatibility paths, reorder packets, waive non-pass evidence, or begin a later packet early.

rollback-strategy.rule: If generated inventory or validation heuristics produce unstable churn, stop before source mutation work and correct the classification logic first.
Do not bind new Compass validation commands into mandatory build pipelines until the corresponding coverage wave is complete.
